topics.headline: Oil spike post-ceasefire collapse raises odds of dual US-EU CPI acceleration
topics.summary: Brent's jump above $85 after renewed Mideast conflict reverses the energy base effect that cooled June's US and Eurozone inflation prints, with practitioners citing 2022's post-plateau rebound as precedent; both regions' July/August readings now face real upside risk, though Fed/ECB officials and thin prediction-market volume urge caution against overconfidence.

topics.headline: HY spreads drift wider as hawkish Fed and tech selloff collide
topics.summary: HY OAS has crept up to 2.77% amid rising rate-hike odds (36%, up from 16%) ahead of the July 29 FOMC decision and a sharp semiconductor-led equity selloff, but spreads remain near historic tights, so any widening from here is likely to be modest rather than dramatic.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETFs hit four-day outflow streak amid Fed hike odds
topics.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs bled ~$49.7M on July 28 (fourth straight down day, led by IBIT), while an unusually live 31.5% Fed hike probability and BTC stuck below $64,402 resistance keep momentum bearish; still, redemptions are concentrated in tactical/hedge-fund holders rather than sticky RIA/institutional accounts, leaving near-term flows fragile but not clearly trend-broken.

topics.headline: VIX near lows, but contango and FOMC signal upside risk
topics.summary: Spot VIX sits around 18-19, below its recent trailing average, with futures in contango (19.07 front-month, 20.54 VIX3M) suggesting the market expects some rise ahead; the July 28-29 FOMC meeting falls squarely in the 30-day window and adds event risk that could push VIX above its 3-month average.

topics.headline: Near-continuous hyperscaler power deal cadence makes 30-day YES near-certain
topics.summary: Beyond the March 4 White House pledge, fresh deals keep landing within the window—Chevron-Microsoft's 20-year Texas PPA, National Grid's $1.75B Joulent investment, PowerPlay AI's Abilene project, and a wave of 2026 nuclear agreements—confirming that new generation/PPA announcements have become monthly-or-faster occurrences rather than isolated events.
